picks.thesis: Both legs fire but at different vintages. Four House members disclosed eight buys, led by Cisneros in the $100,001-$250,000 band on 2/9 (C-17f8c4c8bcd3), with smaller buys from Letlow (C-2fbce0af5cb6) and Allen (C-d6561a502241) — all January-February transactions, now stale. The insider leg is fresh and unflagged for 10b5-1: Chairman and CEO Wei bought $11,187 on 7/7 (I-d53035d3d718) alongside a broad officer group the same day (I-bbd1f32e66c6, I-393d6b8a87e2), then larger discretionary buys by Lin Shyue-Shyh, $74,130 on 7/21 (I-a97690bd241a), and Tien Bor-Zen, $73,060 on 8/3, filed next day (I-3e14608c2626). Shares closed 406.11, down 6.46% in 30 days, above the 90-day low of 374.67.
key_risks: The congressional leg is five to six months old; those buyers' views may have changed without a new filing.

Most of the 7/7 insider buys are uniform $3,000-$5,000 amounts filed on one day, a pattern consistent with routine acquisition rather than discretionary conviction, even though none carry a 10b5-1 flag.
Disclosed congressional amounts are bands, not sizes; the largest cited buy could be anywhere from $100,001 to $250,000.
No committee-alignment signal fired here, so there is no oversight-proximity support in the data.
picks.invalidation: Insider buying stops after the 8/3 filing while the price breaks below the 90-day low of 374.67, or the disclosed House buyers file sales.

picks.thesis: A four-member House cluster in a tight window: Moskowitz on 6/12 (C-0457205444dc), Meuser and McGuire on 6/15 (C-6ad387dafdd4, C-91f202d1541f), Cisneros on 6/18 (C-41f4400dc5f7). Moskowitz is the engine's committee-aligned buyer, sitting on Foreign Affairs and the Judiciary — proximity that raises the stakes and is also why such trades attract scrutiny. Lags run 14 to 44 days, so the cluster only became public well after the trades. Price has since fallen 29.3% in 30 days to 114.53, near the 90-day low of 108.37 and far under the 211.39 high. No insider leg exists.

Zero Form 4 insider buys, so there is no corporate-insider confirmation of the congressional signal.
Moskowitz's filing lagged 44 days, meaning the public learned of the cluster long after it formed.
Three of four buys sit in the smallest disclosed band.
picks.invalidation: Any of the four members files a sale, or the price closes below the 90-day low of 108.37 with no new congressional or insider buying.
